## What it is

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Prepare for a day trip that delivers a whopping punch of value, fun and quality family time in the midst of the subtropical Sunshine Coast hinterland.
>
> Surrounded by serene beauty and the breathtaking gardens, stir up some friendly rivalry with a host of exhilarating activities from mazes to challenging puzzles and more. Put those brain cells to work, then end with a picnic in the gorgeous gardens.
